original_behavior.description: Fail-open fallback: when fresh_pools is empty after slot-window filtering, ALL active non-zero reserve pools are retained regardless of age.
original_behavior.risk: Stale pools (price divergence against frozen/unupdated pools) enter the candidate graph, enabling phantom arbitrage cycles and incorrect profit calculations.
original_behavior.freshness_bypass: Yes — slot window is bypassed when no pools are fresh enough.

fixed_behavior.description: Fail-closed: when fresh_pools is empty, the tick is skipped with `continue`. No stale pool may enter a candidate route.
fixed_behavior.freshness_bypass: No — strict slot window enforced, no fallback.

stale_pool_sources: Discovery catalog entries that haven't been updated via Yellowstone gRPC
Pools removed from the network but still in local cache
Price divergence between cached and on-chain state
recommendation: Always fail closed on freshness. Never retain stale pools as fallback. Add per-pool freshness re-check immediately before simulation.
